name: Circular progress rings
what: A title is typed in, then three ring outlines are drawn one after another on a dark page, a bright arc fills each one up to its percentage, the numbers fade in inside and the names appear underneath; the whole chart floats a few pixels to the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f5-f40 the title is typed letter by letter (a letter every 3 f); f1-f54 the ring outlines are drawn clockwise from the top, one after another (each 25 f, slow start, quick middle, soft end); f57-f105 a bright arc fills each ring up to its number (about 28 f each, one after another); f64-f112 the numbers fade in inside the rings; f75-f104 the names appear letter by letter in a scattered order; the whole chart floats a few pixels to the end (f0-f299)

tracks.name: title
tracks.what: typed letter by letter, each letter fading in from a blur
tracks.easing: linear per letter (3 f each, 5 f fade)

tracks.name: ring outlines
tracks.what: each ring is drawn clockwise from the top, one after another (f1, f13, f29)

tracks.name: arcs fill
tracks.what: a bright arc fills each ring up to its number (f57, f66, f77)

tracks.name: numbers
tracks.what: the numbers fade in inside the rings (f64, f72, f79)

tracks.name: names
tracks.what: the names under the rings appear letter by letter in a scattered order (f75, f85, f95)

tracks.name: float
tracks.what: title, rings and texts float together up to 14 px (at 1280 wide)
